meta.themes: Efficient Computer-Use Models, Agent Platforms Consolidate, Capital Flows Into AI Infrastructure, Governed Automation Moves Into Production

news.title: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra for efficient computer use
news.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra for visual reasoning, computer use, and high-volume professional work at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens.

news.title: OpenAI reorganized its Model Spec around five values
news.summary: OpenAI updated its Model Spec around human intent, harm minimization, honesty, human agency, and care, while adding guidance on context, oversight, and agency.

news.title: Microsoft opened its multi-model Copilot harness in Foundry
news.summary: Microsoft made its Copilot harness available through Foundry, giving developers a managed orchestration layer for 20-plus models, tools, skills, plugins, and long-running agents.

news.title: Anthropic filed for a proposed Nasdaq IPO
news.summary: Anthropic filed an S-1 registration statement for a proposed public offering of Class A shares under the Nasdaq symbol ANT, with pricing and share count still unset.

news.title: Meta outlined up to $95 billion in equity financing for AI
news.summary: Meta launched about $35 billion in underwritten offerings and outlined a future $60 billion at-the-market program to support AI infrastructure and personal superintelligence.

news.title: GitHub said agents started more than 40% of pull requests
news.summary: GitHub's 2026 Octoverse report said agents started more than 40% of pull requests in September, representing 110 million pull requests and sixfold growth since March.

news.title: SpaceX secured $40 billion in GPU financing
news.summary: SpaceX reached a binding commitment for an approximately $40 billion Apollo-managed finance lease covering NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPUs and related equipment.

news.title: Oracle will offer Google TPUs outside Google Cloud
news.summary: Oracle said OCI will become the first hyperscaler outside Google to offer Google TPUs, expanding customer choice for large-model training and agentic inference in 2027.

news.title: Canadian privacy regulators called for accountable health AI
news.summary: Canada's privacy regulators urged governments and health organizations to require privacy-protective, reliable, safe, transparent, accountable, and rights-affirming AI governance.
news.sourceLabel: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada

news.title: Android Studio opened its toolchain to more than 40 coding agents
news.summary: Android Studio Rabbit 2 became stable with support for Claude Agent, Codex, Antigravity, and more than 40 ACP-compatible agents plus official Claude Code and Codex plugins.

news.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows reached general availability
news.summary: GitHub made Agentic Workflows generally available for reasoning-based automation in Actions, with natural-language definitions, sandboxing, threat detection, and model routing.

news.title: Google documented a continuous evaluation loop for agents
news.summary: Google showed how Agents CLI can generate, grade, compare, analyze, and optimize agent evaluations, including scheduled regression runs and threshold-based alerts.
